## What changed?

Explain the change in plain language.

## Why?

What problem or request does this address?

## Preview / how to try it

Add a preview link if GitHub provides one. Otherwise, give short steps to try the change locally.

## Checks run

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Browser check (say which screen sizes or flows you checked)
- [ ] Other checks (list them, or write “none”)

## Screenshots

For UI changes, add before/after or current screenshots and label what each one shows. Write “not a UI change” if screenshots do not apply.

## Backend and security impact

Does this change affect Supabase, authentication, permissions, personal data, secrets, or another backend integration? Describe the impact, or write “none.” Keep secrets out of this pull request.

## Known limitations

List anything incomplete, mocked, or not verified. Write “none known” if there is nothing to report.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change matches the issue or request.
- [ ] I read the changed files and understand the user-visible behavior.
- [ ] Screenshots, checks, and limitations are clear.
- [ ] Requested review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] I am a different teammate from the author and am making the approval decision myself.
